original_proposal: Three sizes, three budgets, two seeds. Refined to four budgets so three calibration budgets remain after holding out one entire budget.
approximate_budget: 6 times all trainable parameters times valid presented next-token targets; updates rounded to 32-target units. Report actual coordinate and target discrepancy.
model: StoriesDecoder modern MHA, two blocks, heads4, no Q/K normalization, hidden2*width, vocabulary16, context8, tied embeddings, FP32 CPU
data: Original stochastic modular-transition fixture; 32 train,32 dev,64 test sequences of9 tokens; no exact sequence duplicates across splits; data seeds6611/6612/6613. Independent sources share an authored transition rule. Training has256 available supervised target slots and is deliberately repeated.
optimizer: AdamW wd0.01, peak0.005/floor0.0005, one peak warmup update then budget-specific cosine horizon; batch4/context8,32targets/update; identical order across widths/seeds, shared init seed per width/budget
selection: Fit dev NLL means per size at target budget using 3 calibration budgets, log optimal N and log loss with explicit assumed diagnostic floor0; require interior optimum at each budget. Freeze prediction or refusal before starting96M budget. Do not change sizes/seeds/recipe in response to heldout outcomes.
evaluation: Retain every calibration/heldout run; evaluate independent test text only after budget prediction is frozen. If optimum unbracketed, report no identifiable optimal-size prediction and preserve entire heldout budget.
scientific_limits: Small finite repeated data, quantized compute, architecture aspect ratio changes with width, budget-specific schedule horizon; conditional local study only. No actual FLOP-meter, wall-time scaling law, TinyStories forecast or large-model extrapolation.
